data.name: Haabeel
data.gender_notes: Haabeel is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Haabeel means 'The One Who is Met'. This name is mentioned in the Quran when Prophet Ibrahim (AS) was willing to sacrifice his son Ismail (AS) as a test from Allah. Ishmael submitted to Allah's will and said, 'O my father! Do what you are commanded. In Allah's name, we put our trust.' (Quran 37:102). This name reflects the submission and obedience to Allah's command.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of submission and obedience to Allah's will.
data.etymology: Haabeel belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Encountered One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Haabeel total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

He is best known for leading the Muslim forces in the Battle of Jaloola (632 AD), where they successfully defeated the Byzantine forces under the command of Emperor Heraclius.
